review_notes: Segment 0: Several Sanskrit/Vedanta terms appear uncertain or possibly mistranscribed and should be checked by a human reviewer before any scholarly use: examples include 'मृद्व्यतिरेकेण', 'इदमुदकम् इति मरुच्चादौ', 'नासतः' (vs 'नासतो'), and the cluster 'नीलोत्पलवत् संघटः, सन्पटः, सन् हस्ती'.
Segment 0: The opening śloka is repeated exactly as in the raw transcript; repetition preserved.
Segment 0: No substantive doctrinal corrections were made; only minimal orthographic normalization was applied.
Segment 1: Term 'सोहलवें' ("सोहलवें मंत्र की व्याख्या") may be an ASR error (possibly 'सोलहवें' or another ordinal). Left unchanged; please verify the intended term.

Segment 1: Phrase 'एवं आत्मानात्मनोः सदसतोः उभयोः अपि द्रष्टा उपलब्धः अन्तः निर्णयः' contains compacted Sanskrit compounds (e.g., 'आत्मानात्मनोः') that were preserved as in raw transcript; please review for correct sandhi/word breaks if a human editor wants to standardize.

Segment 1: The term 'अव्यपलब्धि' (in 'अव्यपलब्धि दशा') retained as in raw text; uncertain if the intended technical term is 'अव्यापलब्धि' / 'अव्यपलब्धता' / 'अनुपलब्धि'. Please verify with the speaker/text source if needed.

Segment 4: निम्नलिखित उद्धरण/वाक्यांशों में स्पष्ट ASR-वर्तनी/वाक्यरचना-अनिश्चितता बनी हुई है — मानव-समीक्षा सुझाई जाती है: "इदं मरीच्यैः मरीचयः अथवा ईमानी मरीचयः" और "इदं मरीची" (शब्द-रूप संभवतः विकृत है)।
Segment 4: कृपया जाँचें: "तस्मात् देहादेः द्वन्द्वस्य च स-कारणस्य असतो न विद्यते भावः इति।" — यहाँ 'स-कारणस्य' का वास्तविक रूप (उदा. 'स्व कारणस्य' / 'सकारणस्य' / अन्य) अस्पष्ट है।
Segment 4: वाक्य "एवं आत्मानात्मनोः सत् असतोः उभयोः अपि दृष्टः उपलब्धः अन्तः निर्णयः।" में शब्द-विन्यास और विभक्ति-संगति अस्पष्ट प्रतीत होती है; मानव-समीक्षा उपयुक्त होगी।
Segment 4: अन्त में "अने ये बिल्कुल..." वाक्यांश भी आंशिक/कटे हुए रूप में रिकॉर्ड हुआ लगता है — मूल शब्दांकन की पुष्टि आवश्यक है।

Segment 5: Sanskrit phrases and sandhi forms were left as in the original unless there was a clear ASR merge or punctuation issue. No substantive Sanskrit reconstructions were attempted where wording was ambiguous.
Segment 5: Only high-confidence ASR and punctuation corrections were applied to preserve the speaker's original meaning and style.

Segment 6: Preserved Sanskrit compounds/phrases as in the raw text (e.g., 'मरीचि-जलवत्', 'नियत अनियत रूपाणि द्वन्द्वानि विकारः अयम् असन्नेव'). Consider human review for canonical/scholarly rendering if needed.
Segment 6: The word 'पारजन' appears in context and may be an ASR artifact or a speaker term; left unchanged pending human review.
Segment 7: Check the term 'आगमापायी' (phrase 'तो ये मनोदशाएँ न केवल आगमापायी हैं') — may be an ASR error or nonstandard word; verify speaker's intended term.
Segment 7: Verify 'सत्ता-वत्ता' (phrase 'इसमें कोई सत्ता-वत्ता है नहीं') — may be misrecognition or colloquial; confirm original wording.
Segment 7: Verify 'राख-वाख' (phrase 'फिर खोजा जाए कि इसकी कोई राख-वाख बची हो') — appears garbled; confirm intended phrase (e.g., 'राख-राख' vs 'राख वशेष').
Segment 7: Verify the phrase 'अधिष्ठान से अध्यास ने सत्ता प्राप्त कर ली' — grammar/wording may be mis-transcribed; confirm intended Sanskrit/Vedanta technical terms.
Segment 7: Removal of 'यस' was done with medium confidence; please confirm that the speaker did not intend to say 'yes' or another word there.

Segment 8: The token 'वादित्य' ("वादित्य नहीं छोड़ते") appears dubious and may be an ASR misrecognition; it was preserved as in the raw transcript but should be reviewed for the speaker's intended word (e.g., 'वाद'/'वादिता'/'विवाद' etc.).
Segment 8: The Sanskrit śloka was normalized with medium confidence; please verify against the speaker's original recitation if doctrinal precision is required.
Segment 8: Many small punctuation and boundary adjustments were made for readability while preserving speaker style and content.
Segment 9: Phrase 'सबकी सहन की सीमा, अप्रतिकार पूर्वकम फाइनल है' was left unchanged; wording is unclear/mixed (Sanskrit/English). Please verify against original audio or speaker for exact wording.
Segment 9: Term 'मिथ्या अवभासते' (Sanskrit) is transcribed as in raw text; uncertain if speaker intended a different Sanskrit form (e.g., 'मिथ्याभासते' or similar). Leave for human review if needed.
Segment 9: Term 'आगमापायी' retained from raw; unclear lexical status — please confirm speaker's intended word.
Segment 9: Kept the English phrase 'this is the finer, very very finer level of तितिक्षा' verbatim as spoken.
Segment 9: I modified the 'छह महीने...' clause with medium confidence; please confirm against audio for accuracy.

Segment 10: Several short Sanskrit fragments/quotations were left as in the raw transcript because their exact canonical forms are uncertain and changing them could alter doctrinal meaning. Examples to review: 'तां स्थितिक्षस्व', 'जो हवा के कशेदम...', 'सो मृतत्वाय कल्पते धीरम्', and 'तस्माद्युद्धस्व'. Please verify these against the speaker's intended Sanskrit if needed.

Segment 11: The term 'इदंता' appears repeatedly and may be an ASR rendering of a Sanskrit compound (possibly 'इदं ततम्' or 'इदं तत्तम्'). I did not change it because the intended Sanskrit wording is not certain; please review for possible correction.

Segment 11: Several Sanskrit phrases (e.g., 'यत्र यत्र इदं तत्र तत्र अविनाशी अस्ति एव', 'येन सर्वमिदं ततम्') were preserved as in the raw text. If a canonicalization to standard transliteration/spelling is needed, please review.
Segment 11: Speaker uses colloquial code-switching (e.g., 'ऐज़ थो ही इज़ साइंटिस्ट'). Preserved as spoken.
Segment 12: Verify the exact Sanskrit rendering/order of the quoted Gītā phrase if strict fidelity is required (minor variations in sandhi/word order appear in the transcript).
Segment 12: Two words — 'निरवयव' and 'निरंश' — may reflect ASR uncertainty; confirm speaker's intended terms if precise lexical accuracy is needed.

Segment 13: Possible uncertain/original terms retained for safety: 'महत्तत्त्व', 'भविष्यवर्ती', and 'जैत्व'. These could be ASR errors (e.g., 'महत्तत्त्व' vs 'महत्त्व', 'जैत्व' possibly 'ऐसा'), but correction might change doctrinal meaning. Recommend human review.
Segment 13: The text preserves Sanskrit forms like 'इदम्' and 'इदं' as in the raw transcript; normalization between these was not attempted to avoid altering intended grammatical forms.
Segment 14: Left ambiguous phrases such as 'किन अविनाशी का...' unchanged because the intended phrasing was unclear from the audio; no substantive doctrinal changes were made.

Segment 15: Segment ends mid-phrase in the following sentence: last token 'होन' appears truncated (continuation in next segment). No other uncertain Sanskrit or technical terms were altered; compounds like 'अद्वैतामृतवर्षिणी' were preserved as spoken.

changes.original: नहि शीतोष्णादि सकारणं प्रमाणैः निरूप्यमाणं वस्तु सम्भवति।
changes.corrected: न हि शीतोष्णादि सकारणं प्रमाणैः निरूप्यमाणं वस्तु संभावति।
changes.reason: Split 'नहि' into standard sandhi-separated form 'न हि' and normalize 'सम्भवति' to 'संभावति' (orthographic standardization).

changes.original: शीतोष्णादि, शीतोष्णादि नियत, अनियत रूपाणि द्वन्द्वानि विकारः,
changes.corrected: शीतोष्णादि नियत, अनियत रूपाणि द्वन्द्वानि विकारः,
changes.reason: Duplicate phrase 'शीतोष्णादि' appears to be an ASR repetition; removed the duplicate to restore intended wording.

changes.original: दो पुद्दियों की चर्चा
changes.corrected: दो पद्धतियों की चर्चा
changes.reason: 'पुद्दियों' is a clear ASR misrecognition of 'पद्धतियों' (approaches/methods) in Hindi.

changes.original: इस तर्क को समझने के लिए दो खंड किया उन्होंने।
changes.corrected: इस तर्क को समझने के लिए दो खण्ड किए उन्होंने।
changes.reason: Grammatical/word-form correction: 'खंड किया' -> 'खंड किए' to match Hindi grammar; spelling of 'खण्ड' standardized.

changes.original: तो सभी चीजें एक-दूसरे के एक-दूसरे के कारण हैं।
changes.corrected: तो सभी चीजें एक-दूसरे के कारण हैं।
changes.reason: Duplicate phrase 'एक-दूसरे के' appears to be an ASR artifact; removed the repetition to restore intended wording.

changes.original: और उस उत्तर के लिए एक पूरी, कहना चाहिए, विचार व्यवस्था हमारे सामने करी।
changes.corrected: और उस उत्तर के लिए एक पूरी, कहना चाहिए, विचार व्यवस्था हमारे सामने रखी।
changes.reason: Likely ASR misrecognition 'करी' instead of intended 'रखी'. Corrected to restore grammatical sense.

changes.original: आलय विज्ञान कारण भी है और आलय विज्ञान कार्य भी है।
changes.corrected: आलयविज्ञान कारण भी है और आलयविज्ञान कार्य भी है।
changes.reason: Corrected spacing in the technical Buddhist term 'आलयविज्ञान' (compound) for consistency with Indic scholarly usage.

changes.original: तो इस विचार को आगे बढ़ाते हुए अंततः जब ये बात आई कि जब घट नष्ट होता है, तो दोनों ही बुद्धियाँ नष्ट हो जाती हैं।
changes.corrected: तो इस विचार को आगे बढ़ाते हुए अंततः जब ये बात आई कि घट नष्ट होता है, तो दोनों ही बुद्धियाँ नष्ट हो जाती हैं।
changes.reason: Removed duplicate 'जब' to correct a redundant repetition and improve sentence flow.

changes.original: विकारबुद्धि
changes.corrected: अस्तिबुद्धि
changes.reason: Context earlier and surrounding text consistently refers to 'अस्तिबुद्धि' (existence-cognition); 'विकारबुद्धि' is an ASR misrecognition that would change the intended contrast.

changes.original: इदमुदकम्
changes.corrected: इदम् उदकम्
changes.reason: Insertion of space to separate Sanskrit words 'इदम्' and 'उदकम्' matching prior occurrences ('इदम् उदकम्') and clarifying the Sanskrit phrase.

changes.reason: संस्कृत प्रसंग में 'इदम् उदकम्' अपेक्षित वाक्यांश है; शब्दों के बीच स्पेस जोड़कर पारंपरिक विभाजन ठीक किया गया (पूर्व संदर्भ से मेल भी खाता है)।

changes.corrected: सामानाधिकरण्य

changes.reason: ASR merged two words; context (previous segment) indicates the phrase should be the pair 'असद् असदेव'.
